notes.f1: Couple, place and the bride's parentage all recovered: R7 links Pedro (2761-R34) to Juana Flores (I1), the place names the Asuncion parish at Avellaneda, and Sebastian Flores / Isabel Rivero are attached via R8/R9. Both register entries were found and cited (S1 QJRM-GV8V, S2 QP84-TH55). The marriage fact carries 30 Aug 1859, the informacion matrimonial date; the agent resolved the date conflict backwards, treating the premarital examination as the ceremony and re-casting the 14 Sep 1859 register entry as a secondary anotacion. Wrong date encoded on the relationship, so partial rather than true.
